description: This Java abstract class provides a base for CLI clients in the Hono project, including dependency injection setup with Spring and Vert.x environment management.

classes.name: AbstractCliClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for CLI clients in the Hono project, handling configuration of Vert.x context and Spring environment.

methods.name: setActiveProfiles
methods.description: Sets active Spring profiles from the Environment, ensuring the environment is non-null.

methods.name: setVertx
methods.description: Initializes Vertx and Context references, enforcing non-null Vertx instance.
